title: Has anyone ever make money using ai for trading?
author: darkcactus69
selftext:
As the title says, I've seen some people posting here and there but most of them ended up as promotion for their ai trading subscription service. 

I just wonder if it's really possible to make self automated ai trading agent profitable and last.

comments.author: EntertainmentSalt825
comments.body: Yes, but don’t expect the ai agent to find an edge for you. You can only leverage it when you understand the patterns you’re looking for

replies.author: GotTermitesInMahHouz
replies.body:
This! 

If there’s an AI that can find the edge on its own and make money autonomously, no one would release it

replies.author: darkcactus69
replies.body: Yeah this make sense, one has to have their own edge and teach their strategy to the AI right? Or just use a code base algorithm to decide when to enter a trade based on their strategy.

replies.author: EntertainmentSalt825
replies.body: Not necessarily teach it to the AI, but more have it test the patterns you think you see.

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: Some people probably do, but it's hard to tell, because most posts show a short stretch of wins and leave out fees and the losing periods. The ones that last usually have simple rules, hard risk limits outside the AI, and months of live results. Cymetica lets you connect your own agent and run it in paper mode first, which is a safer way to find out.

comments.author: Hefty-Mobile8615
comments.body: I haven't seen any reliable evidence suggesting that retail traders can achieve sustained n long term profits through automated AI trading robots. Based on my experience, almost all accounts that claim to have achieved significant success in AI trading are actually juz promoting paid subscriptions or course services. What I truly believe has practical value for AI is its application in research, market data integration n workflow automation, such as broker provided tools like moomooai, longbridgeai or those integrated with their skills like gpt,claude. These tools can better analyze ur positions in a more integrated manner, rather than letting the AI make trading decisions on its own. Although I'm still not satisfied with their slow response n overly lengthy answers. As for actual execution, it is important to adhere to a clear, systematic strategy that is completely controlled n understood by u. Don't rely too much on AI!!! at least not too much on current AI cos after few months or even years, AI may be more advanced n comprehensive lol. I hope this is helpful to you!!

comments.author: ejpusa
comments.body:
Hardcore coders are doing great. They use AI to write their trading stations, (Go, Python) make $500/$1000 in a morning on SPY, and call it a day.

These are bros that have decades of coding experience.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: most of what you've seen sells the subscription because selling is easier than the strategy. the honest route is boring: a plain rule, tested on history it never saw, then weeks on fake money before a cent goes in. Quantradin is something I built for that middle step, free. quantradin.com. what would "last" mean for you, a full year including a bad month?

replies.author: darkcactus69
replies.body: Yeah, just honestly a consistent profit overall, it's ok to lose here n there but in the long run still profitable

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: consistent overall is the hard part to prove, a few months of small wins can hide the one week that takes it all back. I'd want the worst stretch next to the average before believing it. Quantradin, which I made for that check, replays a rule on paper and puts the bad weeks beside the good ones, free. quantradin.com

comments.author: Frodo_Baghodler
comments.body: Yes, absolutely, in much the same way as some human traders make money with their trades. AI traders can look at all the same info, just faster, and makes decisions with less emotion. It's just hard to tell who's actually winning because they're not incentivized to brag about it on Reddit. The people who are incentivized to brag about it here are people trying to sell something regardless of how it performs so they'll be everyone all day long about how good they're doing.

comments.author: drguid
comments.body:
Been a coder for 30 years now but I'm not a quant expert. Being able to get Gemini to knock out ideas for me has been amazingly useful.

Is AI itself good for trading? I have tried machine learning (XGBoost, regression) but to be honest the results were somewhat mixed. What really works? The stuff the big whales use. Technical analysis and charts are for kids. Following the money... that's starting to look much more promising.

replies.author: darkcactus69
replies.body: Did you let the AI to pick it's own entry point using something like following the big money? Or do you still enter a trade manually, just using the AI to gather and present the information so it's easier for you to make a decision?

replies.author: Vegetable-Half-2721
replies.body: And what do you mean by "big whales use"? Could you please give me an example? I always see this—what big whales use... I mean, you can use order flow to get some good alpha, but still, you need tick data.

replies.author: krazineurons
replies.body: How'd you get started with following the money? Any specific Technical indicators?

comments.author: When_moon_and_Lambo
comments.body:
Sort of, and the honest answer is less exciting than people want it to be.

I ran a bot across basically every market on Kalshi looking for edge. Found it in exactly one place, and even there it was thin enough that it barely justified the infrastructure.

What actually changed things for me was giving up on the idea that AI finds edge. It doesn't. It's not a better trader than you are. But it's very good at the boring part, pulling data, cross checking it, flagging the thing you'd have missed at 11pm when you're tired and want to be done.

So I stopped building something that trades and built something that researches instead. That's been far more useful than any bot I wrote.

Short version, it's a research assistant, not an alpha source. Anyone selling you the second one is selling you something.

But I 10x my small starting capital. And if I can do it, anyone can. You just need to be willing to learn and fail and learn more and fail until you succeed.

comments.author: profittoinvest
comments.body: Yes, you can achieve some really great results. There is one condition: you shouldn t just let AI build the bot and the entire strategy for you, you need to know exactly what you want to achieve. You need to know market. After many months of testing, I built a bot myself, it’s delivering in my opinion excellent results, and it will soon be available on the Cornix marketplace. One important thing to keep in mind, never fall for a bot if you cannot verify its performance (backtests) or if you aren't offered at least a two-week free trial. Never share your API keys, and never send money to anyone. If you follow these rules, you’ll be able to find a good bot.

comments.author: Sea-Transportation27
comments.body:
I have. I had AI create a script for me. We backtested it using real data. After 20 versions maybe more. I have a good working model. So far it has been great. Its mostly a swing type system. It was designed to work only with SPY, but im using it for stocks as well. I have had 2 of my best days ever using it. Currently in 10 positions. Stopped out on 2 after gains. I let the winners run and just keep moving my stops up. 

It had buy and sell signals with a table to let me know where in the cycle to stock is. It also tells me when its too late to enter a position if I missed one. 
If anyone wants to see my holding I'll post it tomorrow
